_readme: Permanent ASR correction table (see corrections.py). When you find a transcription error, add it HERE — never fix it inline. Ambiguous terms that are real Korean words in other contexts (리소스, 테이블) belong in phrase_merges where surrounding context protects them, NOT in regex_replacements.

phrase_merges.note: 리소스 is a real word (resource) — only safe with the 파이브 context
테이블 is a real word (table/DB) — only safe with the 파이브 context

regex_replacements.note: 리소스/토소스 deliberately excluded — too close to real words
페이블/테이블 deliberately excluded — 페이블 fable(우화), 테이블 table
